name: sujayath
description: Plugins by Sujayath & Shayan for Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Focused on personal knowledge management, memory, and individual productivity.

plugins.name: remember
plugins.description: Personal memory system for Cowork and Claude Code. /remember to capture chat facts to typed markdown (feedback / projects / reference / people / glossary). /checkin runs a daily ritual with auto-milestones. /refresh-wiki syncs your wiki with atoms. /ingest for bulk documents. Run /lint periodically. Zero infra, pure markdown, your data stays on your machine.
